Monte Carlo flipped hard down-first (66% down, median 5 days to 7,354) and fails every regime threshold, while a zero-cushion ERP at the valuation ceiling and McClellan breadth near its lows continue to refuse confirmation. The posture stays defensive: trim bias into any bounce, patience on re-entry until price reclaims the SMA cluster and breadth stabilizes.
